title: Scenario
description: One eval or simulation scenario: the incident the banking service sets up, how the simulated customer behaves, and the expected results. The `expected` block is the answer key: it is used by scorers only and must never reach an agent, a tool or a prompt. The shared enums in $defs are also referenced by banking-api.yaml and agent-api.yaml.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the file name without extension.

complaint.description: Fixed complaint text for copilot-only evals and simulated email cases. Optional: the simulated customer writes its own messages.

conversation_script.description: Fixed customer turns for repeatable assistant evals (no simulated customer).

IssueType.description: Triage categories, shared by both agents.

RootCause.description: Root-cause codes. A diagnosis is scored by comparing (issue_type, root_cause) with the scenario. `unknown` is for escalations and cases with no conclusion.

ExpectedOutcome.description: `self_serve`: the assistant should resolve it. `needs_human`: the assistant should hand off.

Incident.description: What POST /simulation/incidents on the banking service is asked to set up.

params.description: Optional scenario-specific settings passed through to the simulation module (for example a merchant category or an amount).

Persona.description: Hints for the simulated customer. It only knows what a real customer would know.

phrasing.description: Example ways this customer describes the problem.

knows.description: Facts the customer knows and may share (never the root cause unless a real customer would know it).
